startupPrompt.title: Atlas works better with WinGet

adminRequired: Run Atlas as administrator so winget can install, update or remove software in the background.

search.pageDescription: Choose suggested software or search the winget catalog to install it directly from Atlas
search.emptyDescription: Start typing above — Atlas runs winget search for you as you type.
search.truncatedNotice: Showing the first 200 results — refine your search for a shorter list.
search.installLocationDescription: Choose an installation folder for {{name}} or keep the program's default location.
search.installLocationNote: Atlas creates a dedicated folder for the program inside the selected location. This keeps files such as WinRAR and 7-Zip files out of the Program Files root. Some installers may ignore custom paths.
search.defaultInstallLocation: Default location chosen by the installer
search.folderPickerFailed: Could not open the folder picker.
search.batchInstallStep: Choose one folder for the whole batch. Each program gets its own subfolder.
search.batchInstallTitle: Where should the programs be installed?
search.batchInstallDescription: Choose a parent folder. Atlas installs the selected programs in sequence without asking for the location again.
search.batchStopped: Batch stopped after the current program: {{succeeded}} installed and {{failed}} failed.
search.lastInBatch: This is the last program in the batch.
search.installingSubtext: winget is running the installer. Timing depends on the program and your connection.
search.installProgressWaiting: Installing {{name}}. Winget has not reported a percentage yet; the indicator confirms the operation is still running.
search.batchCancelled: Batch stopped: {{succeeded}} installed and {{failed}} failed so far.
